name: CreateWmEmbedTask

parameters.help_en:
Watermark type. Valid values:  
PureDocument: Document watermark.  
PureImage: Image watermark.  
PureAudio: Audio watermark.  
PureVideo: Video watermark.  
AigcDocument: AIGC document watermark.  
AigcImage: AIGC image watermark.  
AigcAudio: AIGC audio watermark.  
AigcVideo: AIGC video watermark.
parameters.help_zh:
水印类型。取值：
PureDocument：文档水印。
PureImage：图片水印。
PureAudio：音频水印。
PureVideo：视频水印。
AigcDocument：AIGC文档水印。
AigcImage：AIGC图片水印。
AigcAudio：AIGC音频水印。
AigcVideo：AIGC视频水印
parameters.name: wm_type

parameters.help_en: The filename of the file to embed. The backend validates the file type based on the filename extension
parameters.help_zh: 待嵌入文件的文件名，后端需要根据文件名的后缀判断校验文件类型
parameters.name: filename

parameters.help_en: URL for downloading the file to embed. The URL must support public network access.
parameters.help_zh: 可用于下载待嵌入文件的URL，需要可以公网访问
parameters.name: file_url

parameters.help_en: The bit width of the watermark information. The default value is 32. This parameter must be consistent between embedding and extraction. For example, if a 40-bit software development kit (SDK) is used for embedding, this value must also be set to 40 during extraction
parameters.help_zh: 水印信息的容量位宽，默认为32。该参数嵌入和提取时需要保持一致。比如嵌入时使用的是 40 位的SDK，那么提取时也需要将该值设为 40
parameters.name: wm_info_size

parameters.help_en:
Watermark information in decimal numeric format. If this parameter is set, WmInfoBytesB64 cannot be set.  

The valid value range depends on the WmInfoSize parameter:  

When WmInfoSize is 32, the value range is 1 to 4294967295.  

When WmInfoSize is 40, the value range is 1 to 1099511627775.  

When WmInfoSize is 64, the value range is 1 to 18446744073709551615.
parameters.help_zh:
10进制数字格式水印信息。若设置该值，则 WmInfoBytesB64 不能设置。

取值范围取决于 WmInfoSize 参数：

当 WmInfoSize 为32时，取值范围为 1~4294967295。

当 WmInfoSize 为40时，取值范围为 1~1099511627775。

当 WmInfoSize 为64时，取值范围为 1~18446744073709551615
parameters.name: wm_info_uint

parameters.help_en: Base64-encoded string-formatted watermark information. If this value is set, WmInfoUint cannot be set
parameters.help_zh: Base64 编码后的字符串格式水印信息 。若设置该值，则 WmInfoUint 不能设置
parameters.name: wm_info_bytes_b64

parameters.help_en:
Video watermark parameter: whether to use the long-video watermark software development kit (SDK). The default value is false. Valid values:

true: Yes
false: No
parameters.help_zh:
视频水印参数：是否使用长视频水印SDK，默认为false。取值：

true: 是
false: 否
parameters.name: video_is_long

parameters.help_en: Short video watermark parameter: specifies the video bitrate. By default, the video bitrate is automatically retrieved. You can use this parameter to explicitly specify the bitrate used during extraction. This parameter usually does not need to be set
parameters.help_zh: 短视频水印参数：含义为视频的比特率，默认会自动获取视频的比特率，可以通过该参数强制指定提取时使用的比特率。通常无需设置该参数
parameters.name: video_bitrate

parameters.help_en: Image watermark parameter: A higher value indicates greater robustness but reduced visual quality. Default value: 2. Valid values: 0 to 4.
parameters.help_zh: 图像水印参数：更大的值意味着更高的鲁棒性，但是视觉质量会下降。默认值2。取值：0~4
parameters.name: image_embed_level

parameters.help_en: Image watermark parameter: the desired JPEG compression quality factor for the output image. Default value is 95. Valid range: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 图像水印参数：期望的输出图像jpeg压缩质量因子，默认值 95。取值：1~100
parameters.name: image_embed_jpeg_quality

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable invisible watermark embedding. Default value: true.  
Valid values:  
true: Yes  
false: No
parameters.help_zh:
是否启用嵌入暗水印。默认为true。
取值：
true：是
false：否
parameters.name: invisible_enable

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable zero-width character invisible watermark. The zero-width character invisible watermark can resist document insertion, deletion, modification, saving as (with unchanged format), partial text copy and paste, and CopytoTxt attacks. It cannot resist format conversion to PDF attacks. Valid values:

true: Yes
false: No
fields.help_zh:
是否启用零宽字符暗水印。零宽字符暗水印可以抵抗文档增、删、改、另存（格式不变）、部分文本复制粘贴、CopytoTxt攻击。不能抵抗格式转换toPDF攻击。取值：

true：是
false：否
fields.name: invisible_anti_text_copy

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable widget invisible watermark. The widget invisible watermark can resist document insertion, deletion, modification, saving as (with unchanged format), and copying all content in a DOCX file and pasting it into a new DOCX document. It cannot resist format conversion attacks. Valid values:

true: Yes
false: No
fields.help_zh:
是否启用组件暗水印。组件暗水印可以抵抗文档增、删、改、另存（格式不变）、docx全选复制拷贝到新docx文档，不能抵抗格式转换攻击。取值：

true：是
false：否
fields.name: invisible_anti_all_copy

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable visible background watermark. Valid values:

true: Yes
false: No
fields.help_zh:
是否启用背景明水印。取值：

true：是
false：否
fields.name: bg_add_visible

fields.help_en: Visible watermark text for the background. Formatted as a UTF-8 string
fields.help_zh: 背景明水印文案。格式为utf8字符串
fields.name: visible_text

fields.help_en:
Background visible watermark mode. Valid values:

pos: Embeds a visible watermark text at a specific position in the background.
repeat: Tiles multiple instances of the visible watermark text across the document background
fields.help_zh:
背景明水印模式。取值：

pos：在背景的特定位置嵌入一处明水印文案。
repeat：在文档背景中平铺嵌入多处明水印文案
fields.name: mode

fields.help_en: The font size of the visible watermark text. A larger value indicates a larger font
fields.help_zh: 明水印文字字号。取值越大，字体越大
fields.name: font_size

fields.help_en: Color of the visible watermark text. Specified in 0xFFFFFF RGB format. For example, 0x000000 represents black
fields.help_zh: 明水印文字颜色。格式为 0xFFFFFF RGB颜色格式。如 0x000000 表示黑色
fields.name: font_color

fields.help_en: The counterclockwise rotation angle of the visible watermark text, in degrees. Valid values range from 1 to 360
fields.help_zh: 明水印文字逆时针旋转角度。取值范围1~360
fields.name: angle

fields.help_en: This parameter takes effect only when Mode is set to pos. It controls the horizontal position of the visible watermark, with the origin at the bottom-left corner. If the value is between 0 and 1, it represents a proportional position. If the value is greater than 1, it specifies an exact pixel position
fields.help_zh: Mode为pos时生效。控制明水印水平位置的参数，以左下角为原点。数值在0～1之间时，为比例控制。数值大于1时，为精确的像素位置控制
fields.name: pos_x

fields.help_en: This parameter takes effect only when Mode is set to pos. It controls the vertical position of the visible watermark, with the origin at the bottom-left corner. If the value is between 0 and 1, it represents a proportional position. If the value is greater than 1, it specifies an exact pixel position
fields.help_zh: Mode为pos时生效。控制明水印垂直位置的参数，以左下角为原点。数值在0～1之间时，为比例控制，数值大于1时，为精确的像素位置控制
fields.name: pos_y

fields.help_en: This parameter takes effect only when Mode is set to repeat. It specifies the number of times the visible watermark repeats horizontally
fields.help_zh: Mode为repeat时生效。表示明水印在水平方向上重复出现的次数
fields.name: horizontal_number

fields.help_en: Effective only when Mode is set to repeat. Specifies the Count of times the visible watermark repeats vertically
fields.help_zh: Mode为repeat时生效。表示明水印在垂直方向上重复出现的次数
fields.name: vertical_number

fields.help_en: Transparency parameter for the visible watermark. Value range: 1–255. A higher value indicates less transparency
fields.help_zh: 明水印透明度参数。取值范围1~255。取值越大，越不透明
fields.name: opacity

fields.help_en: Parameters for controlling visible background watermarks
fields.help_zh: 背景明水印控制参数
fields.name: bg_visible_control

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to add an invisible background watermark. Valid values:

true: Yes
false: No
fields.help_zh:
是否添加背景暗水印。取值：

true：是
false：否
fields.name: bg_add_invisible

fields.help_en: Transparency parameter for the background invisible watermark. Value range: 1–13. A higher value indicates less transparency
fields.help_zh: 背景暗水印透明度参数。取值范围1~13。取值越大，越不透明
fields.name: opacity

fields.help_en: Control parameters for the background invisible watermark
fields.help_zh: 背景暗水印控制参数
fields.name: bg_invisible_control

fields.help_en: Background watermark control parameters
fields.help_zh: 背景水印控制参数
fields.name: background_control

fields.help_en:
Watermark embedding mode.  
Values:  

lossless_row_shift_embed: Lossless data method  
lossy_number_embed: Lossy numeric method  
lossy_time_stamp_embed: UNIX timestamp method  
lossy_zero_width_embed: Zero-width character method
fields.help_zh:
水印嵌入方式。
取值：

lossless_row_shift_embed：数据无损方法
lossy_number_embed：数据有损方法
lossy_time_stamp_embed：时间戳方法
lossy_zero_width_embed：零宽字符方法
fields.name: method

fields.help_en: Specifies the column to embed into. It is recommended to use a string-type content column. Column counting starts from 1
fields.help_zh: 指定嵌入列，建议为string内容列，计数从1开始
fields.name: embed_column

fields.help_en: Modification precision, indicating the scale of modification, expressed as 10^n. For example, 0 means a precision of 10^0 (units place), -1 means one decimal place, and 1 means the tens place. If a floating-point number lacks digits at the specified precision level, no modification is applied
fields.help_zh: 修改精度，表示修改的幅度，为10的n次方，比如0表示修改精度为10^0，即个位部分，-1表示小数点后一位，1表示十位部分，若float数据无此精度的部分，则不修改
fields.name: embed_precision

fields.help_en: UNIX timestamp watermark parameter. Position where the watermark is embedded. Choose one of Min (minute), Sec (second), or MilSec (millisecond). The algorithm modifies the data at the selected position
fields.help_zh: 时间戳水印参数。水印嵌入位置。可以为Min（分）、Sec（秒）、MilSec（毫秒），三者选一个填入，选择哪个，则算法修改哪个位置的数据
fields.name: embed_time_position

fields.help_en: UNIX timestamp watermark parameter. The format string for parsing timestamps in the CSV file. For example, if the timestamp in the CSV file is similar to “2023-10-15 13:20:59:342”, the corresponding format string is “Year-Mon-Day Hour:Min:Sec.MilSec”. In this case, you must enter “Year-Mon-Day Hour:Min:Sec.MilSec” here. After watermark embedding, the output retains this format. If an incorrect format is provided, this method cannot be used. In the format string, year, month, day, hour, minute, second, and millisecond must follow the above notation. Connectors must be single non-alphanumeric English characters, typically “:”, “/”, “-”, or a space (“ ”). Additionally, “T” and “Z” are supported as connectors. Other timestamp formats are currently not supported for parsing
fields.help_zh: 时间戳水印参数。解析csv文件中时间戳的格式字符串。若csv文件中的时间戳类似“2023-10-15 13:20:59:342”，则对应的格式字符串为“Year-Mon-Day Hour:Min:Sec.MilSec”，则这里要填“Year-Mon-Day Hour:Min:Sec.MilSec”，水印嵌入后依然按照此格式输出，一旦填错则该方法无法使用。格式字符串中的年、月、日、时、分、秒、毫秒必须按照上述写法填写，连接符为英文非字符的单连接符，一般可以是“:”“/”“-”“ ”（空格），额外支持“T”“Z”为连接符。其他形式的时间格式目前不支持解析。
fields.name: time_format

fields.help_en: Bit width of watermark information per UNIX timestamp. Specifies how many bits of information a single timestamp can carry. A larger value theoretically reduces the number of rows required to extract the information, but increases the magnitude of timestamp modification. The modification range is 2^n, where n is the value of this parameter
fields.help_zh: 时间戳水印信息位宽。指定单个时间戳容纳多少信息，这个数越大，提取信息需要的行数理论上越少，但是修改的时间幅度变大，幅度范围是2的n次方，n为此参数值
fields.name: embed_bits_number_in_each_time

fields.help_en: Zero-width character watermark parameter. Embedding density, a floating-point number between 0 and 1. A value of 0 means embedding only in the first row, and 1 means embedding in all rows
fields.help_zh: 零宽字符水印参数。嵌入密度，取值在0～1之间的浮点数，0为仅嵌入第一行内容，1为所有行均嵌入
fields.name: embed_density

fields.help_en: Content of the text watermark. The format is a UTF-8 string
fields.help_zh: 文本水印文案。格式为utf8字符串
fields.name: visible_text

fields.help_en:
Text watermark display mode. Valid values:
pos: fixed position mode.
repeat: tile mode.
top-left: top-left mode.
top-right: top-right mode.
bottom-left: bottom-left mode.
bottom-right: bottom-right mode
fields.help_zh:
文本水印显示模式。取值：
pos：固定位置模式。
repeat：平铺模式。
top-left：左上模式。
top-right：右上模式。
bottom-left：左下模式。
bottom-right：右下模式
fields.name: mode

fields.help_en: Opacity of the text watermark. Valid values: 1 to 255. A larger value indicates less transparency
fields.help_zh: 文本水印透明度。取值：1~255。取值越大，越不透明
fields.name: opacity

fields.help_en: Font size of the text watermark. A larger value indicates a larger font
fields.help_zh: 文本水印文字字号。取值越大，字体越大
fields.name: font_size

fields.help_en: Text color of the text watermark. The format is 0xFFFFFF or #FFFFFF RGB color format. For example, 0x000000 or #000000 represents black
fields.help_zh: 文本水印文字颜色。格式为 0xFFFFFF或#FFFFFF RGB颜色格式。如 0x000000或#000000 表示黑色
fields.name: font_color

fields.help_en: Clockwise rotation angle of the text watermark, in degrees. The value range is 0 to 360
fields.help_zh: 文本水印文字顺针旋转角度。取值范围0~360
fields.name: angle

fields.help_en: Takes effect when Mode is pos. Specifies the horizontal position of the text watermark, using pixel coordinates with the origin at the top-left corner
fields.help_zh: Mode为pos时生效。控制文本水印水平位置的参数，以左上角为原点的像素位置控制
fields.name: pos_x

fields.help_en: Takes effect when Mode is pos. Specifies the vertical position of the text watermark, using pixel coordinates with the origin at the top-left corner
fields.help_zh: Mode为pos时生效。控制文本水印垂直位置的参数，以左上角为原点的像素位置控制
fields.name: pos_y

fields.help_en: This parameter takes effect only when Mode is set to repeat. It controls the horizontal pitch of the tiled text watermark
fields.help_zh: Mode为repeat时生效。控制文本水印平铺水平间距的参数
fields.name: space_x

fields.help_en: This parameter takes effect only when Mode is set to repeat. It controls the vertical pitch of the tiled text watermark
fields.help_zh: Mode为repeat时生效。控制文本水印平铺垂直间距的参数
fields.name: space_y

fields.help_en:
Horizontal anchor point of the text watermark.  
The value range is 0 to 1. When (PosAx, PosAy) is (0, 0), the text is drawn with its top-left corner as the anchor point; when the value is 0.5, the text is drawn with its centroid as the anchor point; when the value is (1, 1), the text is drawn with its bottom-right corner as the anchor point
fields.help_zh:
文本水印水平方向锚点。
取值范围0~1。(PosAx,PosAy)取值为（0,0）时，以文本左上角为锚点绘制；取值为0.5，以文本中心点位置绘制；取值为（1,1）时，以文本右下角位置绘制
fields.name: pos_ax

fields.help_en:
Vertical anchor point of the text watermark.
